`norecursedirs` takes precedence over `--collect-in-virtualenv`.

Therefore, `--collect-in-virtualenv` will not collect tests from a virtualenv whose directory matches a `norecursedirs` pattern. To collect those tests, you must:

1. Pass `--collect-in-virtualenv`, and
2. Override `norecursedirs` so the virtualenv directory is not excluded.

Also, setting `norecursedirs` replaces pytest’s defaults, which include `venv`.
